Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
Return {"answers": {query_id: {"choice": choice, "evidence_unit_ids": [unit_id]}}}.
Select the IDs of the current supplied units that support your classification.
The host retrieves those units exactly. Do not copy, rewrite or repair quotes.
Select all units needed to resolve actors, conditions and cross-references.
Every definite classification needs supporting units. Only an explicitly
declared alternative meaning absence after inspecting the complete supplied
source may have no supporting unit. Unknown may have no evidence. Demonstration
quotes belong to their original sources, never the current source. No extra IDs
or fields. Selecting a unit does not make its interpretation automatically true.

{"operations": [{"choices": [{"meaning": "明示范围是受保护信息本身，未明示副本或衍生材料。", "name": "confidential_information_only"}, {"meaning": "明示范围包括受保护信息及其副本。", "name": "confidential_information_and_copies"}, {"meaning": "明示范围包括信息、副本以及笔记、分析、摘要或其他衍生材料。", "name": "information_copies_and_derivatives"}, {"meaning": "动作仅针对副本或复制件。", "name": "copies_or_reproductions_only"}, {"meaning": "来源明示全部相关材料，但其具体边界由逐字证据限定。", "name": "all_source_stated_materials"}, {"meaning": "窗口给出其他明确材料范围，须按逐字来源保留。", "name": "other_explicit_material_scope"}], "examples": [], "name": "disposal_material_scope_v1", "question": "判断供应处置窗口明示覆盖的材料层级，同时保留逐字来源以约束具体范围。原始 TRAIN 示范（逐字）：“If requested, either Party shall be bound to return any and all materials to the Requesting Party within ____ days.”→all_source_stated_materials；“5.3 The Receiving Party shall return to SINTEC any and all information disclosed by SINTEC as well as any copies thereof automatically upon termination/expiration of the business relation- ship.”→confidential_information_and_copies；“(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor.”→information_copies_and_derivatives。"}], "current_queries": [{"id": "disposal_disposal_material_scope_v1__33_37", "operation": "disposal_material_scope_v1", "unit_ids": [33, 34, 37], "current_units": [{"id": 33, "text": "(e) Not disclose or in any way assist or permit the disclosure of any Confidential Information to any other person or entity without the express written consent of theauditee ; and"}, {"id": 34, "text": "(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor."}, {"id": 37, "text": "(g) Not to send Auditee’s audit information or data and/or any such Confidential Information at any time outside India for the purpose of storage, processing, analysis or handling without the express written consent of the Auditee."}]}]}
